critical_code_review_comments: main.dart hardcodes the ORS API key and MapTiler API key as Dart string literals — for a production app these should be loaded via --dart-define or a secrets file, not committed to source.
VITSuperApp uses .withOpacity() (deprecated in Flutter 3.27+ in favour of .withValues(alpha:)) at lines 136, 139, 254, 257 — non-blocking but will emit deprecation warnings on newer SDKs.
